name: Haruts
title: David's warrior and father of one of David's heroes
summary: Haruts (also spelled Harets) is mentioned in the Bible as the father of Shammah the Hararite, one of David's mighty men. He likely belonged to the city of Harod or the Harar district. His descendants served faithfully in King David's elite forces.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned among the fathers of David's heroes
keyEvents.description: Haruts is mentioned as the father of Shammah the Hararite, one of David's thirty mighty men who distinguished himself in battle.

keyEvents.title: Genealogy in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Haruts' son Ahiam is also mentioned among David's heroes in the parallel list of David's mighty men in the books of Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Deeds of David's Mighty Men
keyEvents.description: David's heroes, including Haruts' descendants, performed great feats in battle against the Philistines and other enemies of Israel.

keyEvents.title: Establishment of David's Elite Forces
keyEvents.description: King David gathered a group of thirty elite warriors who formed the core of his military leadership, and Haruts' family was represented among them.
